headline: Palantine Berm Rekindles as Linn of Mercy Bleeds
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch, combat has reignited across Palantine Berm, breaking its brief lull with four rapid strategic base transfers in the past two hours despite moderating casualty rates. Linn of Mercy continues its grueling attritional slugfest, yielding three further base turnovers around Outwich Ranch and Lathair while exacting more than a thousand casualties over the same span. To the south, Gutter stirred into action as Colonial forces pried loose Suojus, logging three base shifts within six hours. Conversely, the sudden burst of activity in Mooring County has evaporated into near silence, with casualties tumbling to negligible figures and no further territorial movement recorded. Weathered Expanse remains an unrelenting charnel house, devouring nearly twenty-three hundred casualties in two hours without budging its contested lines. Further along the front, Stlican Shelf and the Nevish Line report sharply accelerating casualty exchanges and fresh troop arrivals, though neither theater has suffered strategic base fractures. Rearward sectors throughout the south remain thoroughly pacified, leaving the war's fury tightly concentrated along these contested salients.
